evidence: Touches the libFuzzer fuzzing harness to support custom mutators and adds fuzz testing machinery under src/test/fuzz/
rationale: Enables structure-aware custom mutations for fuzz testing PSBT deserialization and adds harness support for target-specific custom mutators. As the author notes, 'Byte-level mutations rarely produce well-formed key-value maps with valid keydata ... so most inputs are rejected early and the deeper per-field parsing is rarely reached.' While this expands fuzzing depth for PSBT handling, it does not target core consensus or p2p engine paths.
